finding.headline: "Diaspora Dual-Citizenship Birth Registration" (UK baby, Nigerian roots)
finding.problem: "My baby was born here but I'm Nigerian — if I don't register him in Nigeria now he may lose his right to a Nigerian passport and to own land later. I'm terrified I'll mess up the timeline."
finding.person: Nigerian mum in the UK on a Skilled Worker visa; baby born in UK. Must register the UK birth, get a UK passport AND a Nigerian NPC registration/attestation to secure dual citizenship.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (Diaspora dual-registration guide).". Verdict: PASSES.
